**.layout-shift: The page draws its loading line first, then the catalogue fills in, so the content moves. Reserving the catalogue's height is follow-up work.
**.first-paint-swap: The first frame shows static link text that the script then builds into the page's own links, so the words change once. Follow-up work.
**.type-scale: The views use 15 to 16 text sizes and 6 weights. Consolidating them to the scale of 10 sizes and 3 weights is follow-up work.
**.failed-request: The page asks for an optional local-names.json, which only a machine that serves its own names has. The check's server answers 404, as it should.

/.narrow-heading: The headline's 22-character measure is the design's own (.display in loom.css).

/evidence.html.axe: The frozen pre-Loom reader (its bytes are pinned by .github/scripts/__tests__/loom.test.mjs) has one tooltip with no accessible name. Its own axe findings are waived here until the reader is retired or refrozen; no other page is covered.
/evidence.html.lone-word: The evidence reader prints the words of each published record, which change with every build, so a lone last word at a phone width depends on the day. Re-check when the reader is retired or refrozen.
